# 2 Baruch Chapter 38 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**1** He answered me: "I will explain this vision to you — I will explain everything you have asked — because you have been found worthy to receive these revelations.

**2** Many have heard, but few have been shown. Only one person in any generation has truly understood.

**3** So, as I have promised, the interpretation of this vision will be given to you.

**4** And the perfect law of the Most High — which will never pass away or be shaken — will judge those who are found worthy of it."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering. God's affirmation of Baruch's unique status is remarkable: only one per generation has understood. The law as judge (v.4) is not punitive but selective — it recognizes and vindicates the worthy.*
